summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WhatsApp Integration Phase 3 (auto-approval, audit log, daily summary, cron). Backend: 8/8 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All tabs, navigation, and UI elements verified working.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/wa/upload creates inbox item with AI processing
Backend: GET /api/wa/inbox lists items with status filtering
Backend: GET /api/wa/audit with inbox_id and action filters
Backend: Webhook endpoints (GET/POST /api/whatsapp/webhook) handle gracefully when not configured
Backend: Daily summary endpoints (GET/PUT settings, GET preview, GET history)
Backend: POST /api/cron/daily-summary with Bearer auth, duplicate detection via X-Webhook-Id
Frontend: Navigation to Kotak Masuk WA page
Frontend: All 5 tabs present (Inbox, Contacts, Automation, Summary, Settings)
Frontend: Tab navigation working (Automation, Summary, Contacts, Inbox)
Frontend: Automation tab - auto-approval toggles, threshold input, save button, audit log
Frontend: Summary tab - schedule display, enabled toggle, template input, preview button, run button, history table
Frontend: Contacts tab - contacts table, add button
Frontend: Inbox tab - filters (pending, duplicate, approved, all), upload button, inbox items display
Frontend: WhatsApp connection status correctly shows 'Belum Terhubung' (not configured - expected)
notes: Meta WhatsApp credentials are intentionally NOT configured (WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET empty) - this is by design per user request, not a bug
WhatsApp sending is simulated/skipped when credentials not configured - correctly handled in code
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured and working for Gemini AI image processing
WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET is configured and cron endpoint authentication working
Auto-approval logic correctly enforces: confidence >= 0.9, unit matched, no duplicate reference, no warnings
Duplicate reference detection working - prevents auto-approval of duplicate transfers
Audit log captures all actions: received, ai_processed, auto_approved, auto_blocked, approved, rejected, settings_changed, summary_run
Daily summary preview correctly calculates: HM per unit (awal/akhir/total), transfers today, total received, piutang berjalan (saldo_awal + tagihan_bulan - bayar_bulan), pending verifications
Cron endpoint idempotent - same X-Webhook-Id returns 'duplicate' status
Frontend UI in Indonesian language as required
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing
No console errors detected during frontend testing
